periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique diagonal orientation at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, extending upwards towards the cranial pinnas.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid morphology with a vertical-to-horizontal axis ratio of approximately 1.6:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate downward tapering at the inferior-lateral margin of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Significant thickness, covering the entirety of the shoulder region and extending to the mid-thorax.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation approximately equal to 1.8 times the horizontal width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly rounded and smooth semi-circular convex curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-yellow chromophore accumulation/staining across the ventral and abdominal pelage.
